is an opportunity offered by the University of Twente (a public technical university located in Enschede, Netherlands) to non-EU/EEA M.Sc. applicants. This opportunity aims to choose the best candidates to take part in the honours programmes the University is offering. The selected candidates can receive up to € 22,000 for one year.
To be eligible, an applicant must –
have received an application letter from the University of Twente
be enrolled in one of the qualifying UT Masters programmes of 2023/24
not have graduated from UT (under)graduate programme
have a visa from the Netherlands (if applicable)
meet the IELTS and TOEFL parameters
The selected candidates will receive the awards in the following sequence:
Candidates can receive from € 3,000 to € 22,000 for a year.
Candidates applying for the programmes starting in September 2020 are also eligible to get an additional scholarship – Kipaji Scholarship.

Candidates applying for a two-year program hold the chance to receive an equal amount of scholarship, they will receive in the first year. However, to be eligible they need to meet the following requirements at the end of the third quartile of the first year–
Candidates must have an average grade of 7 out of 10

Note: Students can find the details (specific requirements, eligibility, etc.) of the Kipaji Scholarship on the official website of the University of Twente under the University of Twente Scholarship (UTS) programme.
Original qualification certificates in the concerned stream of the study are mentioned in the eligibility criteria.
A government-issued identity proof (Passport/Aadhaar card/voter identity card/driving license/PAN card).

The candidates will be shortlisted based on the fulfilment of the eligibility criteria.
Only candidates already enrolled in a Master’s program at the University of Twente can apply for the scholarship. They must have an admission letter to apply for the scholarship.
Applicants must have their unique student number to proceed with their scholarship application.
Candidates getting rejected in round 1 of the application will not be considered in round 2.
Candidates can receive only one UT scholarship.
UT will provide the scholarship as compensation for the study costs of a student. No additional tuition fees will be paid by the University.
Candidates must comply with the conditions for getting an entry visa in the Netherlands.
Candidates must comply with the English language tests (IELTS and TOEFL).
Candidates are not eligible for a Dutch study loan.
UT scholarship is not available for Master’s programs at the Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation (ITC).
UT scholarship is not available for the pre-Master program.
